parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MatchedHost
parameters.description: The domain name or IP address.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The detection type. Valid values:
- **api**: the domain name list of API assets.
- **abnormal**: the domain name list of risks.
- **event**: the domain name list of security events.
